d407b4d6f9.q: What is the Leadership and Society Initiative at the University of Chicago?

0cff722f5c.q: What does Geoff Curtis mean by describing job loss as purgatory rather than transition?
0cff722f5c.a: Geoff Curtis chose the word purgatory to describe the time of transition and need to learn about oneself, framing it as less about cleansing and more about how to learn about yourself and make yourself better for the next thing. He felt transition or pivot signaled more progress than he was willing to admit, and he wanted a word that described hanging there trying to figure it out and being okay with being unfinished.

7c5710befc.q: What new definition of success is Geoff Curtis pursuing after his career identity crisis?

He is trying to understand what values matter to him as a person—not work-related values or to-do list items—and ensuring those values, rather than external metrics, define how he feels day-to-day.
